dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When do you usually wear a mask?

dialogues.speaker: Ezana
dialogues.text: You can wear a mask whenever you feel like it.

dialogues.speaker: Ezana
dialogues.text: But normally, you'll see more people wearing them on holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Ezana
dialogues.text: Also, when there's a competition, many people wear the masks of the tribe they support as a way of cheering on their warriors.

dialogues.speaker: Ezana
dialogues.text: But normally, you can just wear it as a fancy accessory.
